title: Catholic archival reports of aerial phenomena

tellings.quote: which I found but I also found reports of aerial phenomena by Catholic people from Europe and Canada and United States from 1200 to 1800

plain: The claim is that Catholic archives, including those of the Vatican, hold reports from Catholics in Europe, Canada and the United States describing strange things in the sky, dating from 1200 to 1800. A scholar named Diana Pasulka says she found these herself while working in the archives. If so, sightings like today's would go back many centuries.
